cd /app/tmp/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, time, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
from stress import mk_trace
import random

rng = random.Random(3)
K = 8
fields = [{"name":"n%d"%i,"type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":1000} for i in range(4)]
fields += [{"name":"c%d"%i,"type":"COUNT","min":0,"max":100} for i in range(2)]

def build_full(depth, ty, nodes):
    """build a term tree of depth<=4 filling the node budget"""
    if depth >= 4 or nodes[0] <= 1:
        nodes[0] -= 1
        if rng.random()<0.5:
            return {"aggregate":"mean","field":rng.choice([f["name"] for f in fields if f["type"]==ty]),
                    "from":rng.randrange(K),"to":K-1}
        return {"field":rng.choice([f["name"] for f in fields if f["type"]==ty]),
                "at": "$" if rng.random()<0.6 else rng.randrange(K)}
    nodes[0] -= 1
    if rng.random()<0.6:
        return {"add":[build_full(depth+1,ty,nodes), build_full(depth+1,ty,nodes)]}
    return {"scale":rng.randint(-8,8),"term":build_full(depth+1,ty,nodes)}

atoms=[]
for i in range(20):
    ty = "SIZE" if i%2 else "COUNT"
    # left budget ~ 40 nodes, right ~ 24 nodes
    nl=[40]; nr=[24]
    left = build_full(1,ty,nl); right = build_full(1,ty,nr)
    atoms.append({"quantifier":"any" if i%2 else "all","from":0,"to":K-1,
                  "predicate":{"cmp":rng.choice(["le","ge","lt","gt"]),"left":left,"right":right}})
# count nodes
def count(t):
    ks=set(t)
    if ks=={"field","at"} or ks=={"const","type"} or ks=={"aggregate","field","from","to"}: return 1
    if ks=={"scale","term"}: return 1+count(t["term"])
    if ks=={"add"}: return 1+count(t["add"][0])+count(t["add"][1])
print("node counts:", [count(a["predicate"]["left"])+count(a["predicate"]["right"]) for a in atoms])

def rand_row():
    return [rng.randint(f["min"],f["max"]) for f in fields]
train=[mk_trace("tr%d"%i,"s%d"%(i%16),[rand_row() for _ in range(258)]) for i in range(16)]
probes=[mk_trace("pr0","s0",[rand_row() for _ in range(128)])]
queries=[mk_trace("q0","s0",[rand_row() for _ in range(1031)])]
req={"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,
     "policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
     "train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}
text=json.dumps(req)
print('input bytes',len(text))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=text.encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%(time.time()-t0),'out',len(p.stdout))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']),'queries',len(r['queries']))
print(p.stderr.decode()[:400])
EOF
